intent: A closing call to action on a dark panel where light rises over a horizon drawn in ordered (Bayer) dither: one colour quantised into five levels, a crisp horizon hairline and a scanline reflection. Monochrome silver by default; one accent prop recolours the whole light.
stack: motion/react (variants with a custom start time, useInView)

layout.page: black; @container on the section, 12/20/24px padding on an inner box (@xl, @5xl)
layout.panel: rounded 24px (32px from @xl), #09090b, inset top highlight, 1px white/6% ring, min-height 560/640/700px
layout.content: centred column; notes pinned to the bottom with mt-auto
layout.horizon: 40px above the first note, re-measured by ResizeObserver (panel + notes) and on document.fonts.ready, never per frame

headline.wrap: balance; words are inline-blocks so the line still balances

typography.notes: mono 11px uppercase, tracking 0.14em, white/60, dark text-shadow

color.approach: monochrome first; one accent drives every coloured pixel
color.accent: prop, default silver #d9d9d6 (try a brand hue such as #ff6a3d)
color.levels: panel -> mix(panel, accent, 0.22) -> mix(panel, accent, 0.5) -> accent -> mix(accent, white, 0.65), chosen per cell with an 8x8 Bayer threshold
color.hairline: white up to 70% under the sun, fading to 0 within 38% of the width either side
color.buttons: white primary, dark-glass secondary; no coloured glow anywhere

motion.timeline: one T object from the moment 35% of the panel is in view: panel fade 0, eyebrow 0.08 (its rules draw outward at 0.18), headline words 0.14 + 15ms each with the muted clause a 70ms beat later, body 0.30, primary 0.38, secondary 0.43, light rises 0.36 -> 1.31, notes 0.62 + 60ms each
motion.rise: ease-out expo over 950ms; the sun climbs from 0.78 to 0.28 of its own vertical radius below the line, so it reads the same on a tall phone panel
motion.shimmer: the one ambient loop: multiplies existing light +-14% with two slow sines; never adds light to dark areas
motion.lean: a lean prop (default 0.12, a fraction of the panel width, so up to 6% of the width) sets how far the light shifts toward a mouse pointer, eased 6% per frame; 0 keeps it centred
motion.fps: 30, paused offscreen and in hidden tabs
motion.primaryHover: calm: background dims to #ececec and the arrow nudges 2px in 150ms; no glow, lift, growth or magnetism; press 0.98
motion.reducedMotion: one still frame of the risen light (redrawn on resize and when fonts land); copy is a 150ms opacity fade

responsive.narrow: buttons full width and stacked; notes stacked

accessibility: decorative canvas and fade are aria-hidden
white 2px focus rings offset 4px, keyboard only
AA contrast for all copy (light never reaches the headline or body)

content.headline: Ship the version you’d be proud to demo.
content.body: Book a 30-minute call. We’ll look at what you have, tell you honestly what we’d change, and send a plan the same day.

avoid: a multi-stop orange-pink sunset palette: one accent, derived levels
glowing planet arcs, purple-blue blobs, coloured glows under buttons
magnetic, lifting or growing hover states
light reaching the headline or body copy
dither noise in dark areas (shimmer must be multiplicative)
blurred/smoothed scaling of the dither canvas
